params.1273: Visit your or another clan's citadel.
params.1292: This task will introduce you to clan citadels.
params.1274: The portal to a clan's Citadel is located in the Clan Camp south of Falador.
params.1275: Click on the portal and choose 'Visit my clan' if you have a Citadel to visit.
params.1276: Otherwise choose 'Visit another clan' and type in the name of the clan you wish to visit.
params.1277: If that clan's Citadel is available you will be transported to it.
